channels.name: Notion Community
channels.evidence: phase1_step5_market>: 90% of graphic designers choose the freelance path, and 49% work as freelancers, indicating that freelance designers are active in communities like Notion.
first_actions: Join the Notion Community for freelance designers and post a request for feedback on the template pack.
Engage with users by commenting on their posts and offering to help them with project tracking.

channels.evidence: phase1_step5_market>: 90% of graphic designers choose the freelance path, and 49% work as freelancers, indicating that freelance designers are active in Facebook groups.
first_actions: Join relevant Facebook groups for freelance designers in Egypt and the MENA region.
